name: cache-band
description: Claude Code mod: one line above the prompt with the prompt-cache read rate of the last turn, this session and the whole Mac over the last hour. macOS only; the session and Mac-wide figures need Mini System Monitor (github.com/mlabo-org/mini-system-monitor-rs) with --claude-cache-json.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the band's words. auto follows the Claude desktop app's display language in the desktop Code tab, and elsewhere Claude Code's own language setting, then the locale; English with neither. Languages other than Japanese and English are translated once by a small model call (haiku) and kept. ja or en fixes it. The cache label stays English.

monitorPath.title: Mini System Monitor executable
monitorPath.description: Full path of the mini-system-monitor-rs executable inside the app bundle. Change it only when the app is installed somewhere other than /Applications.
